purpose: Reproducible external-reference boundary for M13 before any Catalyst-derived disagreement can influence the frozen project baseline.

project_baseline.normative_behavior: Frozen M10 FPGA-v1 contract as physically validated through M12
project_baseline.rule: M13 audits this baseline; it does not silently mutate it.

catalyst_n1.pin_kind: annotated repository tag resolved to commit

paper.title: Catalyst N1: A 131K-Neuron Open Neuromorphic Processor with Programmable Synaptic Plasticity and FPGA Validation

native_simulation.known_relocation_issue: The pinned run_regression.sh begins with an author-specific WSL cd path. M13 removes only that working-directory assumption at runtime; the pinned RTL list, testbench list, compile flags, and source files remain unchanged.

sdk_reference.simulator_claim_in_source: Cycle-accurate software LIF simulator matching scalable_core_v2.v

kria_k26_flow.vivado_version_status: The K26 Tcl files do not pin a Vivado version. The same pinned repository's AWS F2 build explicitly sources Vivado 2025.2. M13 will use Vivado 2025.2 for a future K26 reproduction to align with both this project and Catalyst's explicit F2 tool version; that is an M13 reproduction choice, not a claimed Catalyst K26 requirement.

key_source_boundaries.role: top-level architecture, simulator, SDK, and FPGA usage documentation

brian2loihi.project_role: External software interpretation already used for M03-M08 behavioral validation; retained as a distinct evidence column rather than merged with published Loihi evidence.

published_loihi.title: Loihi: A Neuromorphic Manycore Processor with On-Chip Learning
published_loihi.role: Primary published architectural source for Loihi claims.

published_loihi.title: Programming Spiking Neural Networks on Intel's Loihi
published_loihi.role: Published programming/toolchain source and secondary architectural context.

evidence_types.definition: A stable publication, DOI record, or source-controlled document that states a behavior or architecture directly. Statements are attributed to the source and do not become true merely because another implementation agrees.
Behavior produced by executing a pinned implementation, simulator, testbench, RTL, or physical FPGA under recorded inputs and tool versions.
A conclusion drawn from reading implementation source or structure when the behavior is not directly stated in documentation or isolated by an observation. Must be labeled as inference.
A mapping, normalization, terminology choice, or architectural interpretation made by this thesis project. It must not be presented as an external-source fact.

source_authority_rules: Published Loihi material is the primary authority for claims about Loihi itself.
Brian2Loihi and Catalyst N1 are independent implementations/interpretations, not ground truth for undocumented Loihi behavior.
This project's M12-closed Python/FPGA pair is the implementation under audit and remains frozen unless a discrepancy is classified strongly enough as A or B.
Agreement among implementations increases confidence in a shared interpretation but does not prove undocumented Intel microarchitecture.
Implementation source may establish what that implementation does, but not what Loihi necessarily does.
independence_rules: Do not copy Catalyst RTL, simulator equations, state-machine code, constants, or implementation structures into the project's computational core.
Catalyst source may be inspected to identify architectural questions, understand native configuration/trace fields, reproduce Catalyst itself, and classify differences.
Any project baseline change must arise from stronger evidence and a minimized project regression, not from a desire to make outputs agree with Catalyst.
Native source/trace artifacts must be preserved alongside normalized representations so mapping errors can be distinguished from architectural differences.

discrepancy_classes.B: project interpretation/specification incomplete or inconsistent with stronger Loihi evidence
discrepancy_classes.C: Catalyst N1 makes a different architectural choice
discrepancy_classes.D: Brian2Loihi makes or exposes a different modeling choice
discrepancy_classes.E: published Loihi evidence is ambiguous or insufficient
discrepancy_classes.G: feature is unsupported or outside the project's validated subset

required_steps: Create a minimized directed regression reproducing the issue.
Update the applicable normative project specification/source model.
Regenerate or update dependent HLS/RTL if behavior changes.
Rerun every affected M12 physical-conformance gate.
Record which prior thesis claims/evidence were superseded.
change_control.default_for_C_through_G: Document as architecture, ambiguity, mapping, or scope; do not force agreement.
